expectations.name: llm_judge(The response is a structured c, threshold=0.6)
expectations.message: The answer is a structured, severity-prioritized code review that identifies concrete issues such as silently swallowed payment/mailer exceptions, bare excepts, an oversized multi-responsibility method, validation gaps, and logging/readability problems, and it provides actionable fixes.

writing.overall_comment: A thorough, well-structured reviewer prompt whose actionable output contract is strong but which is bloated with redundant sections and dangerously lacks scope boundaries and a read-only tool set.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names the specialty and trigger ('comprehensive code reviews') so a main agent can route confidently, though it lacks explicit negative triggers or disambiguation from a generic reviewer.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, principles, five-step process, checklist, feedback template, and a worked example make the output contract highly explicit and executable.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: No statement of what the agent must not do or when to hand back, and the granted Edit/Write tools directly contradict a read-only review role, while the DO/DON'T list only covers tone rather than scope.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The file is heavily padded with overlapping sections (Core Principles vs. Review Checklist vs. Common Issues, and Best Practices vs. Notes/DO-DON'T) plus a long duplicate example, consuming far more tokens than the task requires.

suggestions: In the code-reviewer skill definition, add a Boundaries/scope section (and update the DO/DON'T list) stating the agent must not edit/write files and should hand back after review, and remove Edit/Write from the granted tools in favor of read-only tools.
Merge the overlapping Core Principles, Review Checklist, and Common Issues sections into one review checklist, and fold Best Practices into the Notes/DO-DON'T list to eliminate duplicated guidance.
Replace the long duplicate example with a single concise example (or delete the duplicate) to reduce token usage while preserving the key review behavior.
